name: supplify-v2
description: Supplify v2 - Clean rebuild with Keycloak-first authentication

scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,gateway "pnpm -C apps/web dev" "pnpm -C apps/api-gateway start:dev"
scripts.build: pnpm -C apps/web build && pnpm -C apps/api-gateway build
scripts.db:migrate: cd apps/api-gateway && pnpm prisma migrate dev
